name: num_tvg
parts: run_groups: U64, R + 1 entries; the groups of run r are [run_groups[r], run_groups[r + 1]) (layout offsets)
group_start: U32, G + 1 entries; group g is stored rows [group_start[g], group_start[g + 1]) (row positions)
group_key: U32, G entries; the pair code (tag, version) shared by every row of group g (index key)

layout.summary: the 27 parts of storage num unchanged, then a group index over num's stored order: per run its group range (run_groups), per group its first row (group_start) and its pair code (group_key). A group is a maximal range of rows of one run with one pair code.
layout.units: run_groups: group indices; group_start: stored row positions of num; group_key: num pair codes (positions in num's pair list)
